features.name: NativeBoundaryContracts
features.scope: Native import/export bindings, NativeCallable contracts, native function-pointer identities, target layout facts, and complete structural/binding validation; no native Body execution.

features.name: RootlessNativeValues
features.scope: Admitted native scalar/address/function-pointer and Blittable Copy values, fields/places, pointer operations, unsafe authorization, initialization and backing-flow facts.

features.name: DirectNativeCalls
features.scope: Native callable imports and selected dependency calls with target ABI staging, results and source-independent consumers.

features.name: NativeExportEntries
features.scope: Explicit method/data exports, native address formation, indirect calls, pointer transport and resolved code origins.

features.name: NativeInterfaceCalls
features.scope: Ordinary interface calls through the selected target's native vtable ABI and effective per-method NativeCallable contracts.

features.name: NativeDataImports
features.scope: Direct static/data imports through Link or Dynamic resolution using admitted rootless representations and provider mutability authority.

features.name: NativeExceptionUnwind
features.scope: Selected target/runtime native exception unwinding into Terrum, event normalization, NativeException materialization and contained reverse-boundary behavior.

record_constraints.CallSite.resultKind: None with resultIndex 0 is valid for an exact unit result or a DoesNotReturn target; normal non-unit calls require a Register or Home result. DoesNotReturn calls use general CallSite forms and terminate the Block; compact window calls return normally
record_constraints.BlockEntryState: Value carrier requires accessKind 0 and a complete value type; PlaceHandle requires accessKind 1..5 and a complete referent type
record_constraints.RequirementFailure: conditionKind 1 requires bool and predicateMask 0; conditionKind 2 requires uint8 and tests (value & predicateMask) != 0 with mask 0..15
